entries.content:
MIMICA, the Storage Pokegirl MIMICA, the Storage Pokegirl

Type: Very Near Human - Near Human (Metamorph)
Element: Ghost
Frequency: Rare
Diet: Human Diet, Blood, Or none if possessing an object
Role: Storage Manager, Bodyguard
Libido: Average, Very Low if possessing an object
Strong Vs: Bug, Fighting, Poison, Psychic, Rock
Weak Vs: Dark
Attacks: Lick, Dazzle, Teleport, Phase, Nightshade, Haunted, Area Illusion, Swallow, Spit Up, Phantom Blade, Hypnosis, Bad Breath, Slash, Possess (objects)
Enhancements: Night Vision, Enhanced Reflexes (x2), Enhanced Strength (x2), Telepathy, Longevity (Possession only), Subspace Pocket (ESS), Enhanced Senses (Vision, Hearing, Olfactory)(x4), Enhanced Memory, Recovery, Reduced Feral, Metamorph (Possession only), Summon (Armor, Item), Levitation (Possessed Objects only), Fast Healing (Blood)
Evolves: None
Evolves From: None
Revised: August 2011

When this interesting breed was first discovered, it explained some strange events Tamers have come across in the past. Waking up to find an empty pokeball, backpack, or other container kissing or talking to them; discovering odd 'talking' urns, cages, boxes, or other objects. While most of these experiences were chalked up to be hallucinations, the Mimica breed was discovered early in the 100's after specimens were brought in to researchers. Now known in modern times for their storage capacity, the breed is utilized by researchers, pet owners, tradesman, and tamers alike.

Though the breed technically has three distinct 'forms', Mimica are only truly able to change the shape of objects they possess. This usually amounts to a single eye or a pair of eyes, a large fanged maw with long tongue, and two arms, often black and skeletal, coming from the object that the breed is possessing. These storage pokegirls prefer containers over other mundane objects, and use the openings as the 'mouths' of their possession form. The breed cannot speak in this form, but through clever use of their Telepathy and moving the mouth of the object, they can appear to be speaking normally. So long as the object being possessed weighs a quarter of the pokegirl's lifting ability or less, the breed is able to lift the containers off the ground and levitate them at a low height, usually no higher than the pokegirl is tall. With practice and experience, individuals are able to increase this lifting ability to one half of their physical lifting ability, and up to twice as they are tall.

The second form of the breed is their taming form. Mimica as a breed show only a few differences from normal human women, this is usually in hair and skin color. Skin tones are usually dark, ranging from human 'dark' skin to more gray in pigment, from off white to true black. Eye colors are usually within the normal human range, though occasionally colors are inverted or iris colors stray out of the human range. Hair color is typically dark as well, and occasionally has hues that are outside the human norm. Height of the breed is typically from 4 to 5.5 feet (1.22 - 1.68 meters) in height. Closely related to their secondary form is their armored form. Mimica possessing an object have the ability to summon armor related to that object and slightly alter their appearance by changing skin tones and hair colors to match or complement their armor. This armored or 'locked' form is typically a stylized form of whatever object they happen to be possessing, from poorly constructed cardboard padding to the typical leather or nylon material backpacks are created from, to strong metals or stone from vaults or urns. For objects that have been enchanted or treated to be stronger or more resistant to damage, this carries over to the armor as well.

With the breed's enhanced memory, Mimicas are able to memorize and keep track of anything they're holding, as well as items they're placed in charge of. Often seen in supply management outside of tamer's harems, this breed is well known at banks, libraries, and other areas where their ability to keep track of items is put to use. Often attributed to being pranksters as well, this varies by individual and is often seen as a trait of younger members of the breed. Some older members don't mind using pranks to delay, confuse, or drive off would-be robbers though. A tendency for kleptomania has also been noted, though this is often more noticeable of feralborne members than domesticates. As the breed is often in their possession form, they tend to make decent betas, but the alpha position is dependent on the individual. Many tamers instead use them as an early warning system, having them possess their backpacks or an empty pokeball worn on their belt and allow the breed to utilize their enhanced senses to forewarn them of danger.

While many pokegirl breeds are capable of accessing a pocket dimension, no other breed has the space or capability of holding a variety of items like the Mimica breed. This variation of the subspace pocket is often referred to as the Expanded Storage Space, or ESS. This space is initially small, usually about 10 feet tall and 20 x 20 feet wide, and can hold about 25 separate items or about 200 pounds worth of material. As the individual pokegirl gains experience in keeping items in this subspace pocket, they can also learn how to expand it's carrying capacity. Experienced Mimicas have been noted to be able to have a space of about 15 feet tall and 40 x 40 feet wide and almost the same carrying capabilities as a pokepack (Maximum holding capacity recorded so far has been 75 separate items and 400 lbs). The size of the possessed object doesn't seem to correlate with the size of the ESS, though more experienced Mimicas are able to open up a gate into their ESS without the need of going through the opening of the possessed item. An item's insides turn pitch black when under this breed's possession, and opens into the pocket created by the pokegirl. Even inexperienced members of the breed are able to allow outsiders into their subspace pocket if the possessed item is large enough, usually through the means of a ladder, stairs, or doorway leading into and out of the ESS.

The inside of this area often appears as a basement created out of materials that make up the item, shelving, tables, or boxes of the same materials are also present, as a stone or brick basement with wooden shelves, or as a cave or other natural 'pocket'. It is speculated that this variation depends on the individual pokegirl's experience and disposition. Many members of the breed only allow those they trust into their ESS, due to the pokegirl feeling anything done to the insides of the dimensional pocket. Research has gone into seeing if Mimica are able to increase either their own ESS or the storage space of items such as pokepacks or enchanted backpacks, and even the most experienced Mimicas utilized in the study were only able to open up their normal separate subspace pocket outside of the usage of the other storage capabilities of the object. It is theorized that the method that this breed uses to open their ESS is actually centered on the pokegirl, with the item possessed used as a focus or 'switch' that enables the breed to open up their subspace pocket. This theory has been given more credit due to more experienced members of the breed being able to create their own item to possess.

Mimica do not battle directly very often, preferring to use subterfuge and various items to battle from afar. Some have been known for keeping heavy or sharp objects to spit at enemies, along with their other attacks. Assisting their harem sisters in battle is where the breed really shines, able to pull out needed items like weapons or healing salves to aid their fighting harem-mates. When in trouble themselves, the breed can also fall back on drinking blood in order to speed their own healing abilities. More experienced members of the breed can also use their gates to their ESS to teleport others by opening the gate in one area, closing it, and then re-opening it elsewhere. Sadly, this tactic, along with being a container for a robber and their pokegirls, that have been used to commit robberies with the Mimica as well. Some stores and sensitive areas have banned the breed unless stringently vetted to not be a security risk.

This unique ghost breed seems to have no preferences, other than being tamed while within her own ESS, and often enjoy the items being used upon them as taming aids. Some enterprising tamers have had used their Mimica's ESS as a safe place to sleep while out in the wilderness, often moving camping gear into the breed's pocket dimension. Luckily, the air in the dimension is recycled through what is likely a process of the subspace pocket itself. Most members of the breed have no way of creating running water or other facilities, though some tamers have gotten creative and often use their pokegirl's ESS as a mobile home.

Related to the breed's object possession ability, Mimicas sometimes become attached to their items as closely as a Slicer is to their weapon. If the object is about to be destroyed, the breed sometimes chooses to stay in their beloved item and perish, though many individual's survival instincts kick in and cause them to abandon the item and mourn it afterward. Other members of the breed have no compunctions about jumping from item to item. The breed also has the ability to designate an object to open up to their ESS for their tamer or harem sisters to use. When this is done various symbols appear around the opening of the object, though they can remove the objects connection to their when ever they want.

Ferals of the breed tend to be aggressive unless possessing an object. Once possessing an object, the breed tends to have extreme kleptomaniac tendencies, looking for items to place in their ESS. They also become much less confrontational, preferring to flee instead of fighting. If they do fight, it's often with launched objects, either through their container openings/mouths or through gates, depending on how experienced the individual pokegirl is. This ghost breed is known to be difficult to capture when feral, though many tamers have claimed success with various methods, usually baiting the pokegirl out into the open with various items.

Threshold directly into a Mimica is extremely rare, as most families don't have enough of the breed in their ancestry to affect a thresholder's chance. Threshold is usually a fast affair, with the skin changing color and the thresholder finding an extreme attraction for hording objects near or in containers. Threshold usually completes when the new pokegirl possesses one of the containers or other objects in her horde. This is also why hording as a mental disorder is often referred to as 'Mimica Touched'.

MILOTIT, the Divinely Beautiful Pokegirl MILOTIT, the Divinely Beautiful Pokegirl

Type: Very Near Human
Element: Water/Flying
Frequency: Extremely Rare
Diet: Fish, Water Plants, Fruits
Role: Eye Candy, Long Range Support, Sex Battles
Libido: Low to High
Strong Vs: Fire, Ground, Fighting, Bug
Weak Vs: Electric, Ice
Attacks: Aura Barrier, Aura of Grace, Aura of Love, Chilled Arousal, Cupid's Bow, Dragon Breath, Hydro Pump, Hyper Beam, Phantom Touch, Probing Tongue, Water Tower
Enhancements: Levitation, Enhanced Strength x5, Enhanced Endurance x5, Enhanced Agility x3, Dragon Affinity, Youthful
Evolves: None
Evolves From: Feeblass (confidence + orgasm)
Revised: Jan 24 2011, 22:05 PM

The Milotit was only recently discovered in 209 AS by a ranch hand who attempted to make a more presentable and attractive Feeblass for sale to the wealthy and eccentric. The beautified Feeblass wasn't purchased, though she did receive a good number of compliments from her would be pet owners. One resident Mahavi inadvertently triggered the transformation during a taming session after wards. Since then, many tamers have successfully recreated the conditions to evolve the less attractive Feeblass into the sensual Milotit.

The most notable difference from her pre-evolved form is the Milotit's incredible beauty. While many Feeblass can be 'prettied up', her evolution transforms her into quite stunning Pokegirl. Gone is her long fish like tail, instead replaced with long supple humanoid legs. The breed's smooth skin varies in colour from a creamy peach colour to a well bronzed tan, and her silky hair can be of any colour of the rainbow. Milotits evolved from feral born Feeblass often have shining, velvety smooth scales the same colour as their hair, covering their arms from past their elbows and legs down past the knees. A Milotit's proportions can range from gently curvy to voluptuous, her bust varying from C-cups to buxom double Es. Regardless of her exact measurements, those that own a Milotit always find her the perfect shape. This beauty persists regardless of her age, as Milotit Pokewomen well over the hill never seem to be a day over their prime.

There's a trend in Milotit personalities, and it is born of their awareness of the beauty they now posses. Milotits know that they are stunning, and often take pleasure in flaunting their new assets. They also gain an intuitive sense of sensuality and sexuality, which if it doesn't drive her to constantly attempt to seduce her tamer or harem sisters, somehow causes her to subconsciously add a sensual and attractive twist to everything she does.

Milotits as a breed have no taming preferences, though many take greater satisfaction to giving pleasure than receiving it. This tendency, combined with their sensuality and Sexual Intuition ability make them powerful sex battlers. There is even a case of a Milotit single handedly satisfying and defeating a Manage-a-trois in an endurance match.

Like many water types, Milotits love swimming. despite being a water type, they don't need to be immersed in water regularly like other types, requiring only drinking a little more than a normal human does. Incredibly, a Milotit is able to summon water from an unknown source for her powerful water attacks, despite never actually storing excess water within her body. This water is magical in nature, and disappears soon after being summoned.

As a serious battler, Milotits are competent brawlers, on par with many fighting types in terms of physical power, and are able to use a few dragon type attacks to good effect. Where a Milotit truly excels is in her ranged water attacks, able to blast away with torrential levels of her summoned water, as well as being capable of learning Flying and Dragon type attacks. Milotits perform very well with their sister breed, the Gynadose, doubling up on their elemental abilities and complimenting each other's strengths.

The conditions for evolving the Feeblass into a Milotit are not too difficult to achieve, merely requiring that the Feeblass have certain threshold of self confidence with regards to their appearance, and sufficiently satisfying taming session. More often than not, the greatest obstacle to overcome is for Threshold Feeblass, who often have emotional scaring brought on by the loss of their humanity. This can easily be solved by a level five conditioning cycle and starting anew, though many tamers prefer to patient and give their Feeblass time to become comfortable with being a Pokegirl.

It is unknown what the feral state of a Milotit is like. Given the difficulty in achieving this evolution, as well as her near irresistible attractiveness, no one who owns a Milotit has been willing allow such a thing to happen, even for Science. There has yet to be a reported case of Thresholding into a Milotit, though it is believed to be possible as several human girls have been born to Milotit Pokewomen over the years.

MILLIPRISMA, the Prismatic Pokégirl 

Type: Not Very Near Human - Humanoid (Insect Animorph Metamorph)
Element: Bug/Ghost
Frequency: Very Rare
Diet: dead plant matter
Role: Distraction, ornamental Pokégirls, illusionists, artists
Libido: High
Strong Vs: Bug, Dark, Normal, Plant, Poison
Weak Vs: Fighting, Fire, Flying, Ghost, Rock
Attacks: Energy Drain, Invis, Fade, Ominous Wind, Hypnotize, Shadow, Psychic Illusion, Reflect, Mirror Coat, Confusion, Flash, Dark Bomb, Grand Illumination, Luminary, Light Drain, Prismatic Aurora, Brightbeam
Enhancements: Dark Affinity, Metamorph (Alternate Form), Enhanced Senses (Vision)(x6), Aura Sight, Photokinesis, Nightvision, Enhanced Endurance (x3), Enhanced Memory (Colors only)
Evolves: None
Evolves From: Mamaripede (Dream Stone)

Until early in the second century A.S., it was only theorized that the Mamaripede was capable of evolution. After all, the Cutiepede evolved, and many of the parallel evolution paths of Pokégirls possessed a certain symmetry. It was not until a Watcher in the Slot League observed a Mamaripede stumble across a small cache of unrefined evolution stones that the method of achieving this evolution was discovered.

The best word to describe the Milliprisma is “colorful”. They are one of the most brilliantly colored and vibrant (in both attitude and coloration) Pokégirls to exist, and are often placed as displays or ornaments in the social events of the wealthy and influential. In regards to shape, there are few or no differences between Mamaripedes and Milliprisma; at most, the eyes widen slightly, the antennae may lengthen, and there may be an increase of at most an inch in height and bust size. The greatest change is in their coloration. The reflective shell along their back is covered in vivid hues, dozens of colors that constantly shift and change. Their hair is equally colorful, scintillating across the spectrum, and the breed is even more proud of it than they were before evolving. Their eyes are wide and bright, changing colors depending on their mood and reflecting the breed’s love for life.

The appeal of the Milliprisma, apart from their beautiful appearance, can be found in their ability to manipulate light. Milliprisma instinctively manipulate, control, and change light and color in ways unmatched by any other Pokégirl. They can not only bring light to a place, but also take it, returning their surroundings to darkness. By twisting the light and affecting color, they can create purely visual illusions, allowing them to imitate several Psychic-type attacks, such as Flash, Psychic Illusion, and Confusion. It is almost effortless for them to permanently change something’s or someone’s color, and people they dislike may wake up to find their skin is now naturally a repulsive shade of some hideous, unnatural color that defies verbal description and that Researchers have been unable to recreate without the aid of a Milliprisma.

Many Milliprisma can be found as support in the field of entertainment. Their ability to change the coloration of the skin, hair, and clothes of others makes them valuable stage hands, and their ability to affect light is helpful with making truly realistic special effects. They can also often be found as artists. They can change the color on a minute scale, and are considered to be top-notch artists, as their tendency to use illusions means that they are skilled at transferring images from their mind to reality, although they are obviously not as skilled as the Ar-Tits breed is. However, to those who possess the ability, naturally or through magic, to see in ranges of light outside of the spectrum visible to humans find their work in those areas of the spectrum to be absolutely superb. Milliprisma can not only manipulate light, but they are capable in seeing in spectrums far beyond what humans can, capable of seeing not only the “visible” range of light, but can also see ultraviolet and infrared aspects of the electromagnetic spectrum. This is because Milliprisma are the only existing pentachromats; this means that, unlike humans who possess only three types of cones in the eye, they possess five, and thus are capable of perceiving far more colors than any other being possibly could, unless augmented by magic. Not only are the rods in their eyes extremely sensitive, but when exposed to sudden bright light they instinctively darken their eyes, allowing the Milliprisma to see perfectly in anything short of complete darkness and rendering the breed immune to light-based attacks. They are not, however, any more proficient at seeing long distances than a normal human.

Beyond their normal sight abilities, the breed’s Ghost typing allows them to see beyond what normal light or sight could grant. Milliprisma can read people’s auras, viewing different emotions and levels of health as various colors. They do not necessarily know which colors mean which emotions, but it with practice they could determine one’s mental, physical, and emotional state with a brief glance. Due to this Milliprisma often fit in well in a harem environment. They are capable of knowing when others have grievances, and with their vibrant and vivacious personalities are often capable of drawing it into the light and helping correct it. Most Milliprisma dislike conflict, which leads to them doing their best to keeping the harem a cohesive whole. Many Milliprisma lament the loss of their healing ability, so when placed in the Alpha or Beta position often devote themselves to making useful to make up for the lack, although they otherwise lack any special strategizing or planning skill. However, it is rare for the usually lively, energetic, and often flighty Milliprisma to be truly effective at the position, so are best left out of positions of authority.

Milliprisma are skilled combatants, making frequent use of their light manipulating abilities to obtain victory. Their skills in their humanoid form are limited, and Milliprisma are much more effective when in their tauric form, which follows the same pattern of coloration as their shell did before (indeed, it is speculated by Researchers that the increased ability to manipulate light comes from their shell, which is obviously much larger in their Inhumanoid form despite the upper body being covered in human skin rather than being an extension of the shell as it was with the Mamaripede)). The greatest tool the Milliprisma possesses is their ability to control what their enemy sees, and through their blinding and confusing light attacks, Invis, and Psychic Illusion they are almost impossible to find, which is ironic for such a brightly colored Pokégirl. The breed possesses several defensive techniques, including Dark Shield, Shadow, Reflect, and Mirror Coat, which they use to make up for their lack of durability. Many of their offensive attacks affect their enemy in ways other than damage, and most Milliprisma prefer to use these as soon as possible to further weaken their enemy; however, very few of their attacks actually deal a great deal of damage, making the Milliprisma’s battles very long; however, this is rarely a problem, as the breed does have a higher endurance and is not a very active fighter. An injured Milliprisma will generally use Cocoon of Darkness, although this prevents them from affecting the light around them as well. A more combat-effective method of healing for the breed is their Energy Drain attack, which curiously also drains the color of their enemy to gray for several hours.

Despite the obvious upsides to possessing a Milliprisma, not all who have a Mamaripede choose to evolve their Pokégirl. Milliprisma, after all, all vulnerable to more attacks than the Steel-type Mamaripede is, and should the Prismatic Pokégirl ever enter melee combat her loss is assured. It was for this purpose that Milktits were actually created. In conjunction with Chickenlittles, these cow Pokégirls were used in the Revenge War frequently. They were easy to feed in the field, their dietary needs easy to fulfill by simply letting them graze on nearby grass and trees, and the milk their breasts produced provided much needed health boosts for several units of Sukebe's forces. Because they were not the best fighters, however, they were also among the first breeds of Pokégirl to be officially `tamed.' The diary cow Pokégirl’s appearance ranges from fur and vaguely animalistic features to normal-looking girls with small, slightly curved horns and soft, leather-like skin. Most Milktits have features in line with dairy breeds of Pre-Sukube cattle, such as the black and white patched coloration of Holsteins or the smooth brown of a Jersey. However some take on the features of other cattle breeds, like the solid black Angus or rust colored Herford. In reality, however, this only amounts to variations in fur color and horn length (or in the case of 'Polled Milktits' the absence of horns). Their height and skin tones vary greatly as well, and their sometimes regional differences lead researchers to speculate that several types of human and cattle DNA were used in making different strains of this largely variable breed.

This leads some Milktits to be used as assistants, but as they are generally submissive in nature, they rarely make good Alphas or Betas, the majority preferring subservient roles in whatever their setting is. These cow Pokégirls also have something of a maternal streak, and it's not uncommon for them to be seen in households as nannies or the mothers themselves. Friendly, gregarious, and non-aggressive, these bovine Pokégirls prefer the quiet life over the roving life of a Tamer, though they tend to accept most situations as they come.
    One of the most notable features of the breed is their breasts, and not just because they're spectacularly large. A Milktit's breasts are constantly lactating, producing delicious milk to drink. When milked completely, they are never smaller than a D-Cup, but it's rare to see them at such a comparatively small size. A Milktit produces up to 25 gallons of milk per day in optimum conditions (though usually stresses and other factors make this an average of about 10 gallons per day). This constant lactation is due to a variant of Prolactin that is created within the Milktit's blood stream. This means that the breed is constantly producing milk, and the hormone (called Prolactin M) is also present in the milk produced by the breed. Due to the presence of the hormone in the Milk, any female, human or Pokégirl, who drinks fresh untreated Milktit milk will begin lactating themselves. This lactation, however, is normal, and is curable simply by not milking the affected female.
    Not milking a Milktit will not stop her lactation though. Luckily, due to the elastic collagen nature of the breed's breasts, they can handle up to a whopping 45 gallons of milk before their system takes over and begins leaking the milk from their nipples at a constant rate due to pressure. For the Pokégirl, being that full of milk is an extremely unpleasant feeling, and that much milk has their breasts so large that they immobilize the bovine type. If a Milktit remains unmilked for up to a week, they will be immobilized by the sheer size of their own breasts. At that point, usually their breasts are sensitive to the touch as well, inducing pain. In liberal and some Moderate leagues, allowing a Milktit to go unmilked for that long is considered abuse, and there are fines and punishments that are levied accordingly.
    Most of the breed do not take to battling well, as they don't have many offensive moves. Milktits are more suited to a support role, where they can use their moves to distract or annoy their harem sister's opponents, or stay on the sidelines and use their innate abilities to give their sisters aid. To do this, the breed falls back on their milk producing ability. Inside their breasts is a series of glands which they can use to alter their milk's effects, creating a healing potion, a sedative, a libido enhancing drug, or a hypnotic. Most often during battle, it is the healing milk of this dairy Pokégirl that can keep her harem sisters going.     Taming a Milktit depends usually on the demeanor of the individual Pokégirl, though universally the breed has shown a love for any type of breast play. Due to their variable libido, Tamers should scan their individual Pokégirl in order to know their taming needs instead of relying on the generalized entries of the Pokédex. Preferences, besides the aforementioned breast play, are usually up to the individual, as Milktits can be seen in almost every fetish at least once, including the more risqué taming styles such as bondage or domination.
    Feral Milktits are herd based Pokégirls, traveling in tandem with others of their kind and browsing the land and raising Pokékits when left alone. When attacked, the breed tends to stampede, the entire group of Pokégirls running madly away from danger and trampling everything in their path. Some wily feral predators have learned to simply chase down Milktits and separate them from their herd before pinning them and drinking their fill. However, more often than not, predator Pokégirls are after the bovine type's meat, and not her milk. Single ferals tend to be highly skittish and flee from most forms of what they perceive as danger. If a tamer wishes to catch a Milktit in the wild, often the easiest way is to take a page from the predatory ferals and single a Milktit off from her herd. Some liberal tamers have claimed that another method is more gentle and viable. Offering up some tasty fruit and have a non-threatening Pokégirl lie prone on the ground nearby. A word of warning for this method, however, if the tamer makes a wrong move, they may wind up trampled.

Mileeboros are an interesting conundrum. Their bodies are amongst the sexiest of all Pokégirl-kind. They have round, full breasts, ranging from B to DD cup, skin that is smooth and dark, an attractive dark brown with some greenish tint to it, curvy hips, a sexy rump, long legs, surprisingly delicate-looking hands, an althetic build, and silky hair. They also have six glassy yellow eyes, which can extend out on stalks, allowing a Mileeboro to look in every direction at once.

Not the most attractive face in the world.

Feral Mileeboros tend to be solitary, peacefully eating what they can find. When confronted with a newcomer into their territory, they become fierce, attacking all out with vines from their hair and teeth, 90% of the time using their trademark attack, Bad Breath, right off the bat. The problem to catching one is the fact that Bad Breath is such a potentially powerful attack, and tends to drive people off to heal the status problems it causes before actually trying to catch the Mileeboro. If the Tamer and his Pokégirls manage to outlast the Mileeboro’s stamina, there is a fifty/fifty chance that they will try and run away from the fight.

Tamed Mileeboros tend to prefer clothing that reveals as much of their sexy bodies as possible, while keeping their mouths covered by a mask or a veil. Their face is an embarrassment to them and they aren't fond of Tamers looking at their faces for long, preferring to flaunt their bust and bodily curves. They love to use Bloom and Buttsprout on themselves, wanting to enhance their figures as much as reasonably possible to draw attention away from their faces, becoming surly if people stare at their faces too long. In terms of Taming, both Ferals and Domestics prefer to be Tamed from behind, Domestics not wanting their Tamers to look at them in the face, Ferals simply because they like it that way. Very rarely will Domestics accept a Taming from the front, usually only from a Tamer who has shown them enough love that they feel comfortable showing their unmasked faces to. There are occasionally jealously issues with this breed, especially with more beautiful Pokégirls. This can be solved, however, by showing equal affection to the Mileeboro. Touching and/or caressing their face is a good way to get their affection and maintain it. As a related side note, Mileeboros tend to get along well with less attractive breeds, such as the Feeblass and Giant Trollop. These jealously issues only occur in Domestic Mileeboros, however.

During the Revenge War, Mileeboros were among the many Pokégirls sent into cities to cause general havoc among the populace. Their Bad Breath attacks would cripple the response times of human forces and make it easier for stronger Pokégirls to move in and start casualties. Sometimes Mileeboros would head in with the stronger Pokégirls, using their powerful jaws in addition to their toxic Bad Breath attacks. This was usually contrary to orders, but if the job got done, no one complained. They briefly were very rare in the waning days of the war, as human soldiers learned to take them out from a distance before they could use their Bad Breath attack on them.

The Bad Breath that is their trademark attack comes from their ability to purify soil and eat most harmful chemicals without negative affect. They absorb pollutants out of an area of ground through their root-like feet, and into a specialized lung, their stomachs capable of converting consumed toxins into their Bad Breath attack. The more toxins converted into the Bad Breath mist, the more potential status effects the attack can unleashed. They can also convert bodily wastes from eating carrion and plant-matter into Bad Breath mist, although the effect will not be as potent. Due to this, Mileeboros are more commonplace in industrial areas rather than in the wild, and are often seen working together with other Poison-types that consume wastes. In many cases, they are used with other Pokégirls that consume waste products, allowing for very effective waste management in large urban areas. Mileeboros can also be found abundantly in harsher natural environments, such as swamps and peat bogs.

As an odd side note, a Mileeboro’s normal breath is actually quite pleasant. This is unusual, considering their Bad Breath attack, but it’s assumed to be a case of the Bad Breath not being connected to their regular lungs. Another unusual thing to note, so far only noticed among Feralborns, is that they tend to have an usual fondness for headgear. Hats, crowns, earmuffs, they like anything that can be put on their head. Researchers have dismissed this as an extension of the need to mask their unpleasant facial appearance many members of the breed feel the need for, although this is regarded by some as inconsistent, as Feralborns tend not to want to wear veils to hide their face, being unashamed of their looks.

Feralborn Mileeboros have very casual harem dynamics. Once adapted to a harem, they easily make friends with their harem sisters and can get along with most anyone. Domestics have a much harder time of it, being shy and embarrassed about their new appearance. It’s only with care and affection that they can overcome any insecurities they may have. They don’t take well to insults, especially about their appearance, but this can be solved by disciplining the involved Pokégirls.

Threshold cases do happen, but a great number of them end with the girl requesting a level 5 taming cycle, or attempting suicide. Most of the suicide cases are stopped and healed, being placed in level 5 cycles upon their restoration.

In the beginning part of the Revenge War, before Sukebe had managed to create many pokegirls capable of teleportation, he had to have his troops rely on specialized pokegirls that were capable of conveying them across vast distances to where the next battle would be. Though he had flying types, and his tauric pokegirls, none could carry more than perhaps a few passengers at a time. That is, not until great birds were seen in the sky, like something out of a fantasy novel of the time, carrying a rather large number of pokegirls that would drop into a battle from above. When teleport-capable pokegirls became more common, they were used to get such pokegirls to safe teleportation points to set up strategic staging areas for the more specialized troops. For the most part, however, after teleporting pokegirls were 'born' and brought up to date, the Mikila became a part of the support structure for Sukebe's armies- though fairly tough, their great size in bird form left them as fairly simple targets for the human's flying weapons. After the war, the breed was practically never seen, especially after the last few hunts in 2 or 3 AS claimed the last lives of the gigantic birds that once flew the skies. Thought extinct for roughly two decades after that, a tamer managed to capture and tame a pokegirl that was originally thought to be a Rack of some sort. However, upon her first transformation into a great bird, researchers soon verified the existence of the Mikila breed of pokegirl. Not too long afterward, several of the breed were utilized to assist in creating a map of what remained of the world's landmasses.

The Mikila breed has two physical forms, and can change between the two almost instantly and at will. Their pokegirl form ranges in height within the standard human female averages, with a maximum height of roughly 2m (6.6ft). Though the breed is commonly lithe in overall build, threshold cases do tend to have larger curves than the typical Mikila, which do not detract from their flying capabilities at all due to the pokegirl's overall light weight. Their eye and hair colors tend to range the human norm, though also can be found in shades of purple, blue, and deep green as well. Such colors are believed to be a result of the blending of avian genetics with the pokegirl DNA to create the breed, though researchers believe this to be fairly unimportant to look into any further than such theories. What truly sets them apart, when in their Pokegirl form, is the pair of large wings that extend out from the pokegirl's back. Each wing is about twice the height of the pokegirl in length, with some individuals having up to two and a half times the pokegirl's height for the width of a single wing (which means that the wingspan can range between 6.4m (21.1ft) at the smallest and 10m (33ft) at the largest). The wings themselves are unlike any known pre-war avian in existence, however. The wings themselves are free-jointed, giving them an unprecedented movement for limbs that were likely originally designed to simply allow them to fly. This, combined with large finger-like ends to the wings that are simply skin-covered rather than covered with feathers, allow her to draw her wings directly behind herself or to allow the breed to wrap said wings around themselves as well. These large finger-like ends are complete with thumbs, and indeed, the furthest reaches of the wings themselves actually are hands. These wing-hands (as they are commonly called) allow the pokegirl to manipulate larger and heavier items with greater ease than the smaller hands on their human-like arms can. Their feather coloration differs per individual as well as the area of the world that the Mikila was born in, and only sometimes happen to match the color of the pokegirl's hair. Known feather colors are white, black, red, blue, green, yellow, and brown (in that order, most common to least common), though it is speculated that there might be other colors not yet seen.

Their bird form, however, is even larger. The pokegirl ceases to appear humanoid at all, and although stands at roughly the same height, looks like a huge avian from pre-war times. At a length that is roughly 2.5-2.8m (8.2-9.1ft; tail feathers make up a good half meter of the overall body length), one would certainly expect their wingspan to change in a similar manner- and it does. The wingspan alone increases to roughly twice the overall wingspan of their pokegirl form (making the bird form's wingspan out to be from 12.8-20m, or 42-66ft). A Mikila in this form can kneel down to stand only half as high, fortunately, and their wings retain their free-jointed nature, which makes them still able to manipulate objects with her wing-arms as needed. The pokegirl's feet change to that of a webbed-talons, though the talons are not very sharp, making them unreliable weapons for drawing blood in any kind of battle. Unlike their pokegirl form, the avian form does have a bird-like beak. They are commonly short, dull, somewhat curved beaks reminiscent of what was known as a 'goose' , though some also have bills like that of brids known as 'ducks.' Far more rare are the elongated, sharp-looking beaks and look more like the beaks found on birds that were commonly called 'raptors' in such times. Their plumage matches the color of the pokegirl's wings in her pokegirl form, though may change in shades and even in patterns compared to that which remains upon the enlarged wings. The sight of such powerful and large avians has often been described as 'majestic' and 'awe-inspiring' by those that have an interest in avian species from before the war... likely a result of so many such species now being extinct in this day and age. While in flight or not, and regardless of form, they can actually control gravity in their immediate vicinity, which can increase or decrease their speed as necessary, as well as those within her personally manipulated gravity field.

When in battle, the pokegirl typically fights from afar using sonic attack techniques to do harm or Gravity to disrupt the opponents. They are somewhat clumsy on the ground, despite being able to fold their wings around their body or against their back while in either pokegirl form or their avian form. Their wing-arms do give them an advantage, however, when it comes to grabbing a target, and can exert great pressure upon it by utilizing a Vice Grip technique. Tamers should note that the breed can utilize the technique known as Bass Explosion, which can cause those who are near the site of the battle to go deaf temporarily, and as a result is banned from various gyms around the world. It is, however, a viable tactic outside of villages, towns, and cities, and can make it much easier to handle certain pokegirls, whether feral or not, once they cannot call for help or hear anything for a short while. Earplugs are quite important for a tamer and his harem, if the Mikila is allowed to use this technique. Oddly, the sound that is a result of the technique sounds like some sort of 'quack', which baffles most tamers that are unfamiliar with what researchers believe the pokegirl's avian genetics to be based from. In most gym battles, however, the Mikila is usually only of limited use, due to the sheer size of their bird form and the size of the arena itself, which is rarely large enough for a Mikila to maneuver all that much within such limited space. The breed is not nearly as adept at sex battles, however, due to the fact that their bird form is actually banned in such venues. With a pleasure threshold only somewhat greater than that of a Titmouse, the breed is almost never seriously considered a contender in such types of battles. It should be noted that upon being badly wounded or knocked out, a Mikila will return to her pokegirl form (a fact that makes it possible to handle feral Mikila that are in their bird form).

The breed is not commonly sought after by tamers, primarily due to the fact that they are not all that useful in battling in indoor environments. That said, they are considered one of the foremost pokegirls for transporting goods and others, which often leads to the breed being utilized by tradesmen and watchers. In the air, they are rather fast, easily attaining over a hundred miles per hour when only lightly burdened and with a good wind and weather, and can maintain such speeds for several hours before needing a rest. This excellent flying speed makes the breed often used for quick delivery of small packages, sensitive documents, and for 'air-mail' services in general. Some skilled individuals of the breed are even used for inter-continental travel, though these individuals are quite rare and require certain training to make it possible. Bearing heavier burdens of over 90kg (on average) will slow the pokegirl down considerably, or force the pokegirl to require more frequent rests along the way. The Mikila love to fly, and dislike being cooped up indoors for too long: a fact made more pronounced by the fact that the breed as a whole enjoy racing in midair. A keen competitive sense makes the pokegirl either a joy to have around or, perhaps, completely unbearable to some people, considering their eagerness to race no matter the competition. This often leads to individual rivalries with other fast pokegirls, like the Cheetit, Chocoboob, and Rapitaur that is most often simply 'friendly' in nature. However, the breed in general can be quick to anger and to retaliate, and yet, quick to cool off. Researchers once attempted to theorize why Sukebe would approve of a breed like this, but no researcher has been able to come up with a reasonable hypothesis to this day.

Mikila are only rarely found feral these days, and are usually found in their humanoid form when they are. Forming flocks upward of a dozen pokegirls strong, they will often fly in a V-formation from place to place, and unlike many pokegirls with of the Rock-type classification, will make their nests near rivers, streams, ponds, and lakes that are often hidden within forests. They are relatively benign and simple ferals, more than willing to share their temporary territories with locals that are do not attempt to attack the flock. However, indiscretions toward their pokekits, being attacked, or otherwise provoking even one of the flock can and usually does lead to the entire flock attacking the offender, which often leads to use of a Bass Explosion technique to force the attacker away. Ferals are also unafraid of feline pokegirls, a rarity among avian-based pokegirls, which can confuse both domestic and ferals that fit that category. A flock of Mikila is migratory, and can be followed to their typically northern nesting grounds in summer, or souther in winter. Threshold cases are not common, but are typically discovered as the pokegirl-to-be has problems with their sight becoming blurry. It takes roughly a week for the blurriness to subside, and when it does, the new pokegirl will automatically transform into her avian form and back again once she has fallen asleep into her pokegirl form. The new pokegirl will be starving when next she awakens- it is recommended to have enough food to feed a Snorlass halfway to sleep on hand when the new Mikila wakes up.

Mostly regulated to assisting healer pokegirls during the Revenge War, the Miasmasaur still holds a similar position in modern times. This poison type dinosaur pokegirl is often used as an anesthesiologist, working along side healing pokegirls such as Cherries, Pollita, and NurseJoys to manage patients pain. The breed is also used alongside other venomous pokegirls for venom research, and to create various pharmaceuticals. Popular opinion on this theropod breed usually paints the herbivorous subtype in a better light than their carnivorous sisters.

Based on the small theropods, the Miasmasaur is broken up into two subtypes based on the breed's diets. The Carnivore subtype actively hunts when feral, and carnivores require their diet to be mostly (around 80-90%) meat in order to avoid malnutrition and other detrimental side effects. Herbivore subtypes require mostly plant matter (75-95%) in their diet to remain healthy. Small theropods tend to be defined as no larger than 1.5 to 2 times the average human height, making this breed have an extremely broad range of appearances. Like other pokegirls based on dinosaurs, this breed can assume a taming form as well as a battle form that appears to be the animal an individual is based upon. Battle forms typically range in height from around 3 to 9 feet (1 - 2.74 meters) regardless of the true heights of their dinosaur bases.

Appearances of the taming form vary not only on the animal base of the breed, but also upon the bell curve of Near Human to Not Very Near Human. On the very left hand of the spectrum, individuals have a tail, smooth scaled skin, and finger and toe nails hardened into functional claws. The addition of feathers or proto-feathering may or may not be present though feathering tends to be present on Carnivore subtypes. On the right hand of the spectrum, individuals appear to be animorphic representations of their battle form. Carnivore subtypes can range among any of the carnivorous species within the suborder Theropoda, though most often tend to be from the Compsognathidae or Maniraptora branches, most commonly some form of raptor or compsognathus. Herbivore subtypes tend to be from the Ornithomimosauria branch, most commonly Gallimimus or Struthiomimus. Skin colors vary from human standard to earthen tones and occasional brighter colors, height typically ranges from around 4-7 feet (1.22 - 2.14 meters) meaning that some individuals actually gain height when assuming their taming form. Hair may be actual hair or feathers, typically in similar tones as the breed's skin.

The breed notably relies on their poison typing in battle, with five available poisons to aid in the task; a damaging poison, a paralyzing stun venom, lust venom, sleep venom, or their numbing venom. The instinctual style of battle for any member of the breed is to poison first, then depending on the subtype attack (Carnivores) or flee (Herbivores). When pressed into battle, the breed often poison first then use their speed and agility to attack from afar with their areokinesis, though like the Flirt line, the breed is unable to fly without gaining extensive experience in the use of their manipulation of the air. Occasionally, the breed will dart back in to apply another Venom Bite, though completely changing out venom varieties takes upwards of 24 hours for the breed.

Patience is often the most attributed personality trait listed for a Miasmasaur, though typically this is more noted for domestics and thresholders, as ferals tend to fall back on their instinctual reactions. Carnivore subtypes tend to be described as having an overly curious mindset, investigating things that catch their attention; while Herbivore subtypes are known to be more cautious, preferring to ensure the safety of themselves and those around them. The breed as a whole tend to be good at thinking under pressure, with a quick wit to match.

Taming preferences vary, though a common complaint about the breed is the habit of dosing their Tamers with lust venom before sitting back and 'enjoying the ride'. Some carnivore types can be aggressive, though this doesn't seem to be in the majority of the breed. Typically, tamers should be mindful of the breed's claws until they are sure an individual Miasmasaur is able to control herself in the taming room.

Feral Miasmasaurs tend to follow their subtypes, with herbivores only posing a threat if they are startled in which case they tend to throw a few techniques before fleeing. Herbivore types are notably more flighty than their predatory sisters. Carnivore subtypes often have bounties, due to their habit of numbing sleeping prey and eating them alive. Tamed ferals are quickly brought to heel on the matter. Psychic and Electric types are often the best choice to capture a Miasmasaur, with Ice and Rock types making up a close second. Typically determining the subtype is the key in capture, as Herbivores can be chased down and subdued easily, whereas Carnivores have to be fought to be subdued. Like their larger cousins, the Zahngeist, paralysis first locks the breed into their taming form before paralyzing them completely, and the taming form lock lasts between two and three hours.

Thresholding directly into a Miasmasaur typically requires a family history of dinosaur breeds with strong flying and poison heritage. Threshold typically begins with the thresholder discovering their areokinesis first, leading to a mis-diagnosis of either being one of the Flirt line or an Airmaiden. The mistake is often quickly discovered, as the the thresholder also discovers the rest of their enhancements, leading up to transforming into their battle form. Once the battle form is obtained, the thresholder is considered a pokegirl, and is usually has to accept whatever changes to her body come with reverting back to their taming form. Thresholders are usually sold into medical or pharmaceutical corporations.

Metalmouse, the Metal Munching Pokegirl Metalmouse, the Metal Munching Pokegirl

Type: Near Human-Animorph (Mouse)
Element: Steel
Frequency: Rare
Die: Vegetarian, Minerals, Metals
Role: Metal creation/digestion
Strong Vs: Ice, Rock
Weak Vs: Electric, Fire, Fighting , Ground
Attacks: Needle Spray, Reflective Blur, Iron Tail, Steel Crusher, Acid Spit, Quick Attack, Bite
Enhancements: Enhanced Speed (X8), Enhanced Durability (X8), Enhanced Endurance (X4), Specialized Digestive System
Evolves: None
Evolves from: Titmouse (Metal Jacket)

A large part of the Revenge war was salvage. Seeing as most of the world was inhabited by the enemy Sukebe’s forces were quick to take advantage of any materials that could be reused from human settlements. One breed that proved vital to the process was the Metalmouse.

Metalmice change significantly from their previous form, their hair taking a grey or silver color. They aren’t very large, rarely standing above five feet. Despite this they tend to be very heavy, averaging about 200 pounds. If not covered in fur, their skin takes a metallic grey sheen. Their breasts are naturally small A-cups, but for reasons unique to the breed they can expand to the size of G-cups.

Metalmice eat metal, not really the biggest of surprises. Their spit has a controllable acidity and their teeth are stronger than diamonds. When they eat metal or certain minerals it mixes with their digestive juices to form a unique element known as murisium. Murisium exists all over the breed, being part of the reason for their hair and skin color. They can also store it in their breasts in liquid form resulting in their breast expanding. It takes at least half an hour for metals and minerals to become melted to the point where they can be reformed as murisium.

When regurgitated murisium quickly hardens and is actually one of the strongest, yet lightest metals known to man. It was a key component in many of the armors and weapons built for Sukebes forces, and it was soon put to use by humans once the breed had been tamed. They are usually paired up along with the Minimouse, supplying materials for construction.

Metalmice are one of the few mice breeds that could be considered for serious tamers. The combination of their speed and Durability makes them capable of lasting much longer than before. They usually use their speed to dart between enemy attacks, while spraying them from afar with needle spray. Occasionally they’ll come in close for a strike, but more dangerous is their bite. Combined with their strong teeth and acidic spit it can be really powerful, and Their speed has allowed some skilled Metalmice to grab blades out of the air with them. They can regurgitate their murisium to a significant length, letting it harden to weigh down or bind their opponents.

Metalmice are fairly friendly Pokegirls. They aren’t much for conflict and would rather spend their time eating then fighting. Despite this, they rarely become obese, most of their food being turned into murisium, but they tend to get pudgy without enough work to do. They still posses the Titimice’s fear of several breeds to a lesser extent. Because their battle style already favors staying at a distance they will fight feared opponents, if reluctantly, at a tamer's orders. If they share a harem with a cat type the two can get along, although the Metalmouse will usually be very submissive in regards to the Pokegirl.

Sadly, when it comes to the breeds newly enhanced endurance, it doesn’t extend to the bedroom. They tend to be slightly less sensitive than they were as a Titmouse, but for a Metalmouse to even be considered average takes much practice. They retain all of their major erogenous zones, and when holding murisium in their chest they become more sensitive if not somewhat harder to play with. At full size some Metalmouse can nearly be brought to orgasm with a simple caress.

When feral, Metalmice spend most of their time eating, although this is more out of necessity than pleasure. The only attack they utilize while feral is bite so when attacked they prefer to regurgitate their food at their opponent, and run away. They’re skittish, but if offered metals, something rather hard to come by in the wild, the breeds will usually stay around long enough for a tamer to initiate a taming session, after which they’ll be fairly easy to catch.

Despite their evolutionary requirements suggesting a rare Pokegirl, the breeds ability to thrive in the wild, along with high consumer interest, has led to a stronger population. Most get put to work in various manufacturing companies. The breed is a common threshold for those of Titmouse and steel type ancestry. Along with the migration of their ears and the growth of a tail, the breed also experiences the growth of stronger teeth which will be important for producing the murisium necessary for their color change.

Metalmice experience a change in their body when pregnant as Pokewomen. The amount of Murisium placed in their breast reduces to a fraction of what it once was and normal milk is produced. This milk mixes with the murisium in their breast to form a drink which only their children can withstand, all healthy children being born with the iron stomach blood gift. This is due to the murisium that they receive along with other nutrients while still inside the mother. Only Metalmice Pokekits and a few breeds with extremely advanced digestive systems can stomach pure murisium. Due to the constant introduction of murisium Metalmice children will exhibit traits similar to blood gifts or curses such as toughness, claws, or Phytodermatosis. These technically aren’t bloodgifts as they are less about the breeds genetics as they are about the introduction of constant levels of murisium to the body from the time of development to the time of breastfeeding. Some argue that since only Metalmice children can stomach the substance that it is a very exclusive type of blood gift found only in the breed, but the debate is still ongoing.

MERCURY, the Liquid Metal Pokégirl MERCURY, the Liquid Metal Pokégirl
Type: Humanoid
Element: Steel
Frequency: Rare
Diet: Liquids
Role: Combat, Espionage
Libido: Average
Strong Vs: Bug, Dark, Dragon, Flying, Ghost, Ice, Normal, Plant, Poison, Psychic, Rock, Steel
Weak Vs: Electric, Fighting, Fire, Ground
Attacks: Slash, Tackle, Hammer, Harden, Metal Wrap, Metal Wheel, Morphic Quickturn, Rare Metal Fist, Morphic Blades
Enhancements: Malleable body, Enhanced Strength (x2), Enhanced Endurance (x5), can reabsorb severed limbs
Evolves: Viepra (Venom Stone)
Evolves From: Stretchymaid (Heavy Metal)
    Mercuries were accidentally discovered during a raid on a research facility in 260 AS. Members of the Limbec Pirates attacked the facility, an explosion from a power cable knocking a pair of Stretchymaids that were working at the laboratory into a room stocked with evolution stones. A pair of Heavy Metals came into contact with them, and their bodies changed, giving them greater powers and allowing them to fight back and defeat the two Dronza attacking their Tamers.
    Mercurys are stunning. Because of their morphic capabilities, and liquid metal-like bodies, there is almost no set appearance as a breed. They do all share the one trait that's easy to recognize, and that's that their skin seems to be made of metal. Their abilities seem to be an exact copy of a Titto's at first glance, but in actuality they differ greatly. A Mercury is able to change her appearance to that of any Pokégirl that's similar in size, or else she'll look like a smaller exact copy of the Pokégirl that she's imitating, but she'll always retain the metallic sheen. While the Titto is capable of becoming a, albeit weaker, replica of any Pokégirl, the Mercury is unable to copy their abilities. Most Mercuries prefer to remain in a single form, using her own attacks to win the day or provide enough of a distraction to escape.
    A Mercury is as versatile in her battling as her morphic abilities. A Mercury is able to learn most Sword Techniques simply by morphing their arms into a bladed weapon. While they have a hard time learning any elemental blade, they find that they don't really need it when they can use metallic tendrils capable of entangling or whipping a Pokégirl or running her through by turning the tendrils into thin skewers. A Mercury is able to hold partial body forms for as long as they please, but when it comes to using full body transformations, such as their Metal Wheel attack, they're only able to hold it for as long as they can hold their breath before needing to turn back and breathing. Another interesting feature of the Mercury is that should any part of their body become severed, a Mercury is able to reform herself simply by reabsorbing the dismembered part back into her body. It is also a documented that while a Mercury is able to sprout a pair of metallic wings from her back, her body is far to heavy for her to fly. When asked why they bothered it was because that they mostly sprouted wings simply because it's what their Tamer wanted. With an Average Libido the Mercury is able to hold her own in a Sex Match. While not as skilled as most of the 'girls that are found frequently in the circuit, a Mercury is able to morph a penis of her own to mimic a Steel version of the Plant's Grass Cock sex attack.
    Mercuries all tend to posses a submissive streak. A Mercury will initiate a Taming session when ever she can, although she doesn't need it. For some reason not only are Taming sessions needed to keep the Mercury from going feral, but it was discovered that the sexual excretions from both male and female tamers are needed to keep the Mercury from becoming stiff. They're a favorite playmate of the Domina lines because of their metallic skin. The only thing that Dominas seem to dislike about the Mercury as a play-toy is that, because of their liquid like bodies, they're nearly impossible to hold down. Feral Mercuries are easy to capture even if they're not that easy to find. Feral Mercuries are slow and unable to move all that well, their bodies becoming to stiff and to solid to preform even the most basic of morphing.
    Even though they seem to be made of liquid metal, a Mercury that has undergone her second puberty, they are apparently organic enough to be capable of producing children normally. It is, however, dangerous for any Mercury PokéWoman to attempt any sort of metamorphosis that drastically changes their appearance since it could potentially harm the fetus. Thresholding into a Mercury is rare, with only less than a handful of cases reported.

MENAGE-A-TROIS (aka MENAG), the Undisputed Master Of Sex Pokégirl MENAGE-A-TROIS (aka MENAG), the Undisputed Master Of Sex Pokégirl
Type: Very Near Human
Element: Normal
Frequency: Rare
Diet: Sexual fluids, aphrodisiacs , Human style food
Role: Master Of Sex, Worshipers of Bastit, ‘Libido Heighteners’
Libido: Extreme
Strong Vs: Sex techniques
Weak Vs: Fighting
Attacks: All Sex attacks, Dance, Butter Up

    Where as the Soixante-Neuf was merely dedicated to sex, the Menage-A-Trios (AKA Menag) is sex personified. They could very well live off nothing but sex, sleeping only when driven to complete and total exhaustion and often taking several people to do it as well. In fact, the only way to even obtain a Menag is to have a Xante experience multiple orgasms during an orgy, something so easy for a Xante to obtain that it’s often considered for Menag’s to be more common then their previous form.
    With evolution, Menag gain their own brand of exoticness, despite very much retaining her ‘complete human look’. Often compared to the Succubus, a pokégirl girl known for its near perfection in terms of body proportions and allure, the Menag is often considered to be that perfection. Of course with the girls Aura of Sex, which grows stronger with her evolution, some scientists often argue if it isn’t that aura which makes her more desirable. Most don’t care, as they’re often too busy heading for the girl or their own to sate the growing desires.
    Not surprisingly, All Menag seem to have a love/lust/idol worship fixation on Bastit, the only Pokégirl in existence that they find fascinating, and a true goddess when it comes to sex, something that they wish they could be.
    The Aura of Sex, now around at least a good 100-120 yards from her center, is much stronger, to the point higher libido and lower threshold girls, like Vixxiens and Titmice have been known to orgasm almost as soon as they enter the Aura. A number of male tamers have also experienced the same. This, unfortunately, disqualifies the pokégirl from Sex Battles even though she can turn it off, deemed to give her too much an advantage over her opponents, as well as a distraction to the crowd, unable to handle the already arousing battle type. It should be noted, though, that Aura of Sex for both Menag and Xante are at best guesses. It has been discovered, though that the distance from the Menag's center doesn't effect the power of her aura. This means that some one right next to the pokégirl will feel the same amount of growing arousal as someone at the very edge of her Aura.
    When it comes to the girl being in a harem, Menag are loved for as much for her sexual skill as for her Aura. True to their name, Menag do their best to perfect the art of sex, if not having already done so with all the practice they had as Xantes. Tamers usually leave their low libido girls with the Xante for a little while before taming, returning to be greeted with the girl begging to be tamed.
    Feral Menags are very much like their sisters, often having huge orgies about them to sate their never ending sexual lust. On a few recorded situations, hives of Wasps and Buzzbreasts have vanished for days on end, the discovery of the entire hive having fucked itself to exhaustion being explained by the Menag who caused it being captured and using her Aura to escape.
    Threshold Menags, while not entirely unheard of, are an even bigger danger then thresholding into a Xante. This is because that unlike evolved Menages, the threshold has absolutely no control over her Aura of Sex and is in turn affected by it herself. With her already sky high libidos, there has been more then a few recorded instances of a Menag fucking herself and those she can get her hands on to death. Any threshold Menage should be balled immediately.
